item.title: Blog
item.description:
Perforce

Perforce is an interesting piece of software. Those problems (like the fact that a file can only be one single CL at a time) are understandable sometimes by the goals of Perforce (binary files where merges do not work).

But here are a list of features that make no sense:

  • You cannot print the diff of a new file, because there is no file to compare to. So instead of saying everything is new, nothing is new.
